title: NASA’s The Quiet Crew | Don Durston
description: In this episode of The Quiet Crew, you’ll learn how a flight over Disneyland inspired Don Durston's fascination with airplanes. Don is the Sonic Boom Wind-Tunnel Testing Lead for the agency’s Low Boom Flight Demonstrator project. He is part of the crew on a mission to transform aviation as NASA and communities work together to verify that the X-59’s quiet, supersonic technologies will allow airliners to fly faster over land, cutting passenger travel time in half without disturbing people on the ground.
